finalText:
I've mapped the scope: `account_id` shows up in 1082 places across 94 files.

**Big, but mostly safe.** Internal service code (`services/*/src/service`, `repo`, `http`) accounts for the bulk — those are free to rename.

Three places must not be touched:

| Where | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | Vendored, generated. Comment: "Do not edit, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`" |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, [lib/serialize.js](lib/serialize.js) `WIRE` map | Public API contract, frozen field name per client-facing docs |
| `migrations/*.sql` (already applied) | Historical, e.g. `20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql` says editing won't rename anything in prod and breaks the down step |

The actual Postgres column `accounts.account_id` also can't be renamed by a code find-replace — that needs its own forward migration, separate from this refactor. `lib/audit.js` keeps `account_id` in log lines too, likely for the same wire-contract reason.

Next: sign off on renaming internal service/repo/http code only, but call out the DB column and public API field as separate, follow-up migrations.
